quarterly_data.quarter: Williams Companies press release: Williams Completes Acquisition of Momentum Midstream (09-03-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Williams closed its acquisition of Momentum Midstream on September 3, 2026, expanding its natural gas infrastructure platform in the Haynesville to serve growing Gulf Coast LNG, power and industrial demand. Momentum's Haynesville platform adds more than 4,000 miles of pipe, over 1 million dedicated acres, 6 Bcf/d of gathering capacity, multiple processing and treating facilities and three take-or-pay pipelines with 4.05 Bcf/d of transportation capacity, creating opportunities for future expansions in addition to the two already announced. CEO Chad Zamarin: Momentum 'brings a high-quality customer base, durable take-or-pay contracts and complementary infrastructure'.
